user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain census tract polygons covering the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a census tract polygon dataset covering the full spatial extent of input_3 and suitable for identifying every census tract that intersects State College borough. Treat the returned dataset as a candidate until runtime inspection confirms coverage, CRS, geometry validity, and a stable tract identifier field.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Retain the complete census tract features whose geometries intersect the supplied State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between census_tracts and input_3 using an intersection predicate. Preserve the complete census tract geometries and attributes, and return only census tract features that intersect input_3. Do not guess field names; runtime QC must identify the tract identifier from the observed schema.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean elevation from the supplied complete DEM for every census tract that intersects State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal mean elevation using input_2 as the raster and intersecting_census_tracts as polygon zones. Preserve or emit a stable tract identifier with each mean value. Runtime QC must ground the zone identifier and raster value source from observed schemas and metadata; do not invent field names. Use input_2, whose inspected extent covers the supplied borough boundary and whose grid is 30 m in EPSG:26918.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract candidate must cover the full State College borough boundary in input_3 so all intersecting tracts can be selected.
The retrieved census tract candidate must be available in a GeoPackage-compatible format accepted by the spatial join worker.
The census tract polygons and State College borough boundary must have compatible CRSs for the spatial intersection join.
The retrieved census tract candidate must have an explicitly known CRS before spatial joining.
The census tract candidate must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometries for intersection selection.
The DEM in input_2 and the selected census tract polygons must have matching or otherwise compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The selected census tract polygons must have valid, non-empty geometries for zonal statistics.
The selected census tract layer must contain a stable identifier field so each mean elevation can be attributed to a specific census tract.
